inline_regions.behavior: Ta=A*advance_ratio*k; Tr=B*retreat_ratio*k; k=1.5 if owner component+0xdc0 field+0x24 is 1 or 2, otherwise 1
If deadline nonzero, unsigned now>=deadline clears state and deadline; both pending and expired cases skip state selection this pass
With no deadline and state 0, unscaled B*retreat_ratio>=A adds 5 via slot 29 then sets state 2; otherwise S>50 sets state 3 with randomized deadline; otherwise stays 0
With no deadline and nonzero state, start at 2; if S>70 and !no_advance and B>Ta, choose 4 when B>2*Ta, otherwise 3
After advance branch, if !no_retreat: A>Tr or S<30 gives 0; else S<50 gives 1; otherwise retain state
After base reconsideration, if recovery deadline allows, add (0.5*100)/120 via slot 29 and set recovery deadline now+convert(0.5)
